pairs.subject: quality-regression-gating
pairs.evidence: crates/api/src/tests_prompt_gate.rs:97 The suite pins the promotion gate to a plain Allow when no baseline exists, and a run with mean 0.10 and no baseline also gets a plain Allow (tests_prompt_gate.rs:219-220). So 'nothing to compare against' cannot be told apart from 'tested and passed', which is the unverified-maps-to-green failure the standard names.

techniques.evidence: crates/api/src/tests_prompt_gate.rs:97 The test asserts that a missing baseline gives the same outcome as a pass, with no warning attached. The standard puts 'no baseline recorded' in the unverified bucket, a state separate from passed.

crates/api/src/tests_labels.rs:243 The baseline is stored as a bare scalar next to the judge_model field. The run is posted with no judge or dataset conditions, and the gate still returns status 'pass' (line 265). No test checks the judge/dataset-version predicate before the floor is applied. tests_prompt_gate.rs:48 also passes the baseline as Option<f64>.

crates/api/src/tests_prompt_gate.rs:169 Runs with status cancelled, partial(budget) or aborted and a 0.95 mean are blocked. The reason says 'incomplete' and names the cause, not 'regressed', and only force overrides it.
